mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.board_id, c.member_id, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM comments c LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = c.member_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
